description: This Java class, ThingSearchSignalMapper, extends AbstractSignalMapper and handles the mapping of signals related to search commands such as start, request, and cancel stream. It constructs appropriate TopicPaths based on the command type and support actions, and enhances payloads with command-specific data for communication within the Ditto protocol.

classes.name: ThingSearchSignalMapper
classes.description: A final class that maps signals related to thing search operations, providing methods for constructing topic paths based on commands and supporting actions, and enhancing payloads with relevant data.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Constructs the TopicPath for a given command and channel, using a builder pattern tailored to the command type.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new TopicPathBuilder starting from a predefined namespace.

methods.name: getSupportedActions
methods.description: Returns an array of supported search actions (REQUEST, CANCEL, SUBSCRIBE).

methods.name: setTopicPathAction
methods.description: Sets the appropriate action on the search topic path builder based on the command's name, or throws an exception if unknown.

methods.name: unknownCommandException
methods.description: Creates a new UnknownCommandException for an unrecognized command name.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Configures the search action on the builder based on the specified action enum.

methods.name: fromTopicPathBuilderWithChannel
methods.description: Creates a SearchTopicPathBuilder from a generic TopicPathBuilder and a specific channel, supporting only TWIN channel.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Adds command-specific data to the payload builder, handling different subscription and request commands.
